question: Where’s the closest restaurant in the direction from Spella Park, Algonquin, IL to Legoland Discovery Center Chicago, Schaumburg, IL?
sql: WITH origin_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Spella Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Algonquin%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), target_geom AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Legoland Discovery Center Chicago%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Schaumburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, origin_geom AS og, target_geom AS tg WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ABS(MOD(degrees(ST_Azimuth(og.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(og.geometry, tg.geometry)) + 360 + 180, 360) - 180) <= 45 ORDER BY ST_Distance(og.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
